topics.name: Countable/uncountable nouns, a few / a little, much / many
Modals should / must / can (do's and don'ts)

options: Mona found a lot of information.
Mona found a lot of informations.
Mona found a lots of information.
questions.rule: Information is uncountable, so it never takes -s: a lot of information.

An action going on at a past time takes the past continuous. Mona is singular: was making.

Time is uncountable, so we say a little more time.
